headline: Sensex and Nifty Tumble as Rising Crude Oil Prices and Global Weakness Weigh on Indian Markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices surged above $106 per barrel, impacting market sentiment
Persistent FPI outflows from the Indian equity market
Weak global cues with most Asian markets like Nikkei and Kospi declining
Attractive US bond yields posing a challenge for emerging market equities
whatHappening: Sensex crashed over 850 points, falling below the 23,000 mark
Nifty 50 opened weak and continued to slide following a 0.52% drop in GIFT Nifty
MCX revenue is projected to grow 19% annually through FY30 due to a wider product base
Technical patterns like White Marubozu and rising RSI are appearing in specific mid-cap stocks
summary: The Indian stock market faced a sharp decline on Monday, with the Sensex tumbling over 850 points amid rising crude oil prices and weak global signals. While the broader indices struggled, specific stocks like MCX and Cyient gained attention due to positive growth projections and technical patterns. Investors remain cautious as high US bond yields and FPI outflows continue to pressure domestic sentiment.
